description: Aree di tutela dell'acqua potabile is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices1.civis.bz.it. Aree di tutela per l'acqua potabile istituite/in fase di istituzione ai sensi dell'art. 15 della L.P. 8/2002 per assicurare, mantenere e migliorare le caratteristiche qualitative e quantitative delle risorse idriche destinate all'approvvigionamento potabile pubblico. Coverage: IT. Its keywords include Trinkwasserleitung, Concessioni di acqua, Idrogeologia, Trinkwasser, Acqua potabile, Hydrogeologie. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
